categories.label: Orders & shipping
categories.answer: You can track orders with the link in your confirmation email. Standard shipping is 3–5 business days. If a package is more than 2 days late, reply with your order ID and we will escalate to fulfillment.

categories.label: Returns & refunds
categories.answer: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in original packaging. Start a return from your account → Orders → Return. Refunds post within 5–7 business days after we receive the item.

categories.label: Billing & payments
categories.answer: For invoice or unexpected-charge questions, include the last four digits of the card and the charge date. Do not send full card numbers in chat. A human billing specialist will confirm next steps.

categories.label: Account & access
categories.answer: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. If you are locked out after 2FA, contact support with the email on the account — we never ask for your password or 2FA codes.

categories.label: Product help
categories.answer: Product guides live at help.example.com. Tell us which SKU or product name you have and what you are trying to do; we will point you to the right article.

escalate_message: This looks sensitive or high-risk. Routing to a human agent. Please avoid sharing passwords, full card numbers, or government IDs in this chat.
